description: Search JobsDB job listings, browse by category or location, or pull the newest postings across Hong Kong and Thailand.

advertiserId.description: One or more numeric JobsDB advertiser IDs (comma-separated for OR match) to browse all current listings from one or more employers/agencies. Required for mode=browseByCompany; get an ID from the `advertiserId` field on any previously scraped job. Also works as an optional filter in other modes.
advertiserId.title: Company / advertiser ID(s)

classification.description: Job categor(y/ies). Pick one or more (OR match) — required for mode=browseByCategory; optional filter for other modes. Leave empty for any category.
classification.title: Category

dateRange.description: Only include jobs posted within this window.
dateRange.title: Date posted

jobId.description: One or more numeric JobsDB job IDs (comma-separated, or pass an array) to look up specific listings directly. Required for mode=byJobId; get an ID from the `jobId` field on any previously scraped job. Ignored in other modes.
jobId.title: Job ID(s)

keywords.description: Job title, skill, or company to search for (mode=searchJobs). Also works as an optional refinement in browseByCategory / browseByLocation.
keywords.title: Keywords

location.description: Free-text location/area to browse or filter by, e.g. `Central`, `Kowloon`, `Bangkok`. Required for mode=browseByLocation.
location.title: Location

salaryMax.description: Maximum salary (in the local currency, per `salaryType` period). Leave unset for no upper bound.
salaryMax.title: Salary max

salaryMin.description: Minimum salary (in the local currency, per `salaryType` period). Leave unset for no lower bound.
salaryMin.title: Salary min

salaryType.description: Period the salary min/max values are expressed in.
salaryType.title: Salary period

subclassification.description: One or more numeric JobsDB sub-category IDs (comma-separated for OR match) to narrow a `classification` further (e.g. `6038` = Project Engineering under Engineering). Get valid IDs from the `subCategoryId` field on a previously scraped job. Optional filter for any mode.
subclassification.title: Sub-category ID(s)

workArrangement.description: Filter by on-site/hybrid/remote work arrangement. Pick one or more (OR match). Leave empty for any arrangement.
workArrangement.title: Work arrangement

workType.description: Filter by employment type. Pick one or more (OR match). Leave empty for any work type.
workType.title: Work type

title: JobsDB Scraper Input
